children: Sweden-based cross-border payments platform's Q4 net turnover fell sharply as legacy business ceased
Gross margin for Q4 was 1.2%, reflecting continued pressure on profitability
Company prepared balance sheet for liquidation, secured conditional financing, and cut costs
Valuno says cost base will be fully reduced by end of October 2026
Company says future revenues depend on Atlas platform and new partnerships
Valuno says VAT dispute remains a major uncertainty for future operations
LEGACY BUSINESS CEASED - Co said loss of historical processing business led to sharp drop in net turnover
RESTRUCTURING IMPACT - Co said ongoing restructuring and new revenue models have not yet delivered revenue at expected level
COST CONTROL - Co intensified cost control measures, including management changes and relocation of headquarters
The stock recently traded at 1 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 2 three months ago
